snippet.title: Trials Fusion - After the incident [Europe]
snippet.description:
After the incident DLC#6 is now available in Trials Fusion™!
Buy it now on Uplay: http://bit.ly/1F9sueF

Investigate the causes of the disaster that devastated Earth.

This pack includes the following:
- 10 new tracks including 8 classic tracks, one new “Skill game” track & one new FMX track
- 24 new track challenges 
- New ‘Frontier’ helmet and Roach design
- New editor objects
- And much more!


Get the Season Pass to save over 30% on the 6 DLC Packs! More info on: http://trialsgame.com/seasonpass
